global_organization_chain: Summary: emergency context -> Task 1 danger and fleet -> Task 2 forecast and equipment -> Task 3 signal-safe location -> sensitivity -> budget
Front matter: background -> task restatement -> assumptions -> notation -> voyage capability -> fire-data preparation
Danger interface: gridded records -> frequency/recency/size -> AHP score -> terrain branch -> four classes -> heat-map response
Fleet interface: voyage reach -> two-role cost -> SSA scan/rotation/reserve -> relay candidates -> greedy reuse -> mix-cost Pareto result
Forecast interface: historical event years -> ternary enumeration -> occurrence probability -> residual check -> severity index -> equipment expectation
Placement interface: SPM path loss -> obstacle product -> 20 dB screen -> directional fire spread -> metric safety boundary -> location examples
Evaluation interface: AHP perturbation -> regional frequency response -> strengths -> weaknesses -> annotated primary/additional budget -> References

main_argument_chains.claim: Historical fire records can organize spatial preparedness only after perimeter, time-window, grid, recency, and terrain transformations are explicit.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Freeze inputs and close Equation (3)'s perimeter-area semantics before operational use.

main_argument_chains.claim: Vehicle capability, coverage geometry, duty rotation, preparedness, and attrition answer distinct SSA fleet questions.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Use a common unit ledger and event timeline before accepting the SSA count.

main_argument_chains.claim: Relay geometry and greedy reuse can reduce sites only if candidate sets, coverage invariants, and termination are executable.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Correct and test the printed algorithm before treating its repeater count as feasible.

main_argument_chains.claim: Fleet mix and cost can be compared jointly only when both role costs and the full feasible set are retained.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Reconstruct the incomplete page-13 formulation and solver trace before procurement.

main_argument_chains.claim: An event-year forecast requires a sampling model and out-of-sample scoring, not only arithmetic recurrence counts.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Treat the four candidate years as an internal pattern result until benchmarked and calibrated.

main_argument_chains.claim: Forecast probabilities can inform equipment only through an explicit joint demand and service-level model.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Do not transfer the reported equipment counts without local incident and staffing evidence.

main_argument_chains.claim: Safe repeater placement must intersect calibrated signal feasibility with a metric, uncertainty-aware moving fire boundary.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Repair L2 semantics and coordinate units before using the plotted locations.

main_argument_chains.claim: Local one-factor plots show response direction but cannot establish robust fleet and location decisions.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Add global sensitivity, uncertainty, and decision stability before using robustness language.

main_argument_chains.claim: A stakeholder budget is auditable only when model quantities, role explanations, line-item arithmetic, prices, and replay evidence reconcile.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Correct A$800, 21+21, and A$2.25 conflicts before submitting the request.
